scripts.render: remotion render Reel out/raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 14 && npm run finish
scripts.finish: remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/raw.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=limited -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -t 30 -movflags +faststart out/indonesia-gov-reel.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render ReelVertical out/raw-vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 14 && npm run finish:vertical
scripts.finish:vertical: remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/raw-vertical.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=limited -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -t 30 -movflags +faststart out/indonesia-gov-reel-vertical.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:vertical
